# Xiaomi Global
> Official global Xiaomi website for discovering Xiaomi and Redmi devices, smart home products, support resources, and company information.

Xiaomi Global provides product catalogs, customer support, policy documents, user guides, and brand information for Xiaomi’s international audience across phones, wearables, smart home, and lifestyle categories.

## Product Categories
- [Mobile](https://www.mi.com/global/mobile/): Browse Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones available on the global site.
- [Wearables](https://www.mi.com/global/wearables/): Explore smart bands, watches, and other wearable devices.
- [Smart Home](https://www.mi.com/global/smart-home/): Discover connected home devices and smart appliances.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.mi.com/global/life-style/): View personal electronics and everyday lifestyle products.
- [Discover](https://www.mi.com/global/discover/): Read featured stories, launches, and product highlights.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.mi.com/global/support/): Access Xiaomi customer support resources and service information.
- [Contact Us](https://www.mi.com/global/support/contact/): Find official contact channels for Xiaomi global support.
- [User Guide](https://www.mi.com/global/support/user-guide/): Search product manuals and user documentation.
- [Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/warranty/): Review standard warranty terms and service coverage.
- [International Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/xiaomi-iws/): Learn about Xiaomi international warranty service eligibility.
- [Scooter Safety Notice](https://www.mi.com/global/support/scooter-safety-notice/): Read official scooter safety notices and related guidance.

## Enterprise and Compliance
- [Android Enterprise Recommended](https://www.mi.com/global/support/android-enterprise-recommended/): View Xiaomi devices recognized for Android enterprise deployment.
- [EU Declaration of Conformity](https://www.mi.com/global/service/support/declaration.html): Access regulatory conformity declarations for supported products.
- [Digital Services Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/policy/digital-service-act/): Review Xiaomi information related to Digital Services Act compliance.
- [Data Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/documents/data-act/): Read Xiaomi documentation related to the EU Data Act.

## Community and Content
- [Community](https://new.c.mi.com/global?utm_source=mistore&utm_medium=official_web_tabcommunity&utm_campaign=official_web_mistore_global/?t=1): Join Xiaomi’s global community discussions and announcements.
- [Discover](https://www.mi.com/global/discover/): Explore editorial content, campaigns, and featured product stories.

## Company
- [About Xiaomi](https://www.mi.com/global/about/): Learn about Xiaomi’s company profile and global mission.
- [Leadership Team](https://www.mi.com/global/about/founder/): Meet Xiaomi leadership and founder information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mi.com/global/about/privacy/): Review Xiaomi’s global privacy policy and data practices.

## Popular Support Documents
- [User Guide](https://www.mi.com/global/support/user-guide/): Find official manuals for Xiaomi products and accessories.
- [Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/warranty/): Check warranty terms for Xiaomi devices and services.
- [International Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/xiaomi-iws/): Confirm cross-region warranty support details.
- [EU Declaration of Conformity](https://www.mi.com/global/service/support/declaration.html): Download product compliance declarations for EU markets.
- [Digital Services Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/policy/digital-service-act/): Access platform and policy disclosures under the DSA.
- [Data Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/documents/data-act/): Review Xiaomi’s published Data Act materials.
